title.description: Browser and Google title, 60 characters or less, contains the keyword

description.description: 155 characters or less. Meta description on the static site; card text on the home page

keyword.description: The main search query this page targets

status.description: "draft" until a person reviews the page

updated.description: Date of the last real change, YYYY-MM-DD

ownProduct.description: True if the page names or recommends the site owner's product. If site.json has a non-empty disclosure, the shell shows it

featured.description: Site mode only: list first on the home page and hub pages. No effect in hub or single mode

type.description: Page type: "guide" (how-to or explainer), "comparison" (ranked list or X vs Y), "tool" (calculator or checker). Sets the label and the grouping on hub pages

layout.description: Page shell. "guide" (default): article column with meta line, "On this page", CTA box and (site mode) related guides. "landing": full-width sections, header with logo + CTA only, no meta line, rail or CTA box; start from templates/landing.html. "article": narrow centred reading column with serif headings, no header, no rail or CTA box, slim footer; start from templates/blog-article.html

hub.description: Slug of the hub (topic) this page belongs to, from site.json hubs. Empty = no hub

related.description: Slugs to show first under Related guides. The build fills the rest by hub and keyword

cta.description: Override the site CTA on this page only: the CTA box, the sticky bar, the hub-mode footer button and {{cta_url}}. In hub and single mode the header button keeps site.navCta when it is set; otherwise the header follows this too. E.g. a course page that promotes the course
